name: Log Sheet Operator
description: Creates the daily log sheet, enters hours, runs OCR, generates the client approval link.

name: Log Sheet Maintenance Approver
description: Reviews equipment condition and approves/rejects the Maintenance gate.

name: Log Sheet Sales Resolver
description: Works the Sales exception queue when SAP validation raises a problem and requests re-validation.

name: Log Sheet Operations Approver
description: Gives the final operational sign-off before a sheet can go to Billing; can return a sheet for rework.

name: Log Sheet Billing User
description: Closes billing with a SAP document reference, or places a sheet on billing hold.

name: Log Sheet Manager
description: Full read/write across the module; can act in place of any other Log Sheet role; manages masters.

name: Log Sheet Auditor
description: Read-only access everywhere, for compliance/audit review of the full trail.
